mapper.select: SELECT user_metrics.new_user_count, user_metrics.active_user_count, payment_metrics.paid_order_count, payment_metrics.paid_buyer_count, payment_metrics.gross_paid_amount, refund_metrics.successful_refund_amount, product_metrics.on_sale_product_count, search_metrics.search_count, review_metrics.displayed_review_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.created_at >= #{startAt} AND u.created_at < #{endAt} THEN 1 END) AS new_user_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN u.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_user_count FROM `user` u WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'USER' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) user_metrics CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS paid_buyer_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0.00) AS gross_paid_amount FROM payment_order p WHERE p.status IN (1, 4) AND p.pay_time >= #{startAt} AND p.pay_time < #{endAt} ) payment_metrics CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount), 0.00) AS successful_refund_amount FROM refund_order rf WHERE rf.status = 1 AND rf.refund_time >= #{startAt} AND rf.refund_time < #{endAt} ) refund_metrics CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS on_sale_product_count FROM spu s WHERE s.status = 'ON_SALE' ) product_metrics CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_log sl WHERE sl.created_at >= #{startAt} AND sl.created_at < #{endAt} ) search_metrics CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS displayed_review_count FROM review rv WHERE rv.status = 'DISPLAYED' AND rv.created_at >= #{startAt} AND rv.created_at < #{endAt} ) review_metrics

SELECT metric_date, SUM(new_user_count) AS new_user_count, SUM(paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count, SUM(paid_buyer_count) AS paid_buyer_count, SUM(gross_paid_amount) AS gross_paid_amount, SUM(successful_refund_amount) AS successful_refund_amount, SUM(search_count) AS search_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(u.created_at) AS metric_date, COUNT(*) AS new_user_count, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS paid_buyer_count, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_paid_amount, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS successful_refund_amount, 0 AS search_count FROM `user` u WHERE u.created_at >= #{startAt} AND u.created_at < #{endAt} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'USER' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ) GROUP BY DATE(u.created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(p.pay_time) AS metric_date, 0 AS new_user_count, COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS paid_buyer_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0.00) AS gross_paid_amount, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS successful_refund_amount, 0 AS search_count FROM payment_order p WHERE p.status IN (1, 4) AND p.pay_time >= #{startAt} AND p.pay_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(p.pay_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(rf.refund_time) AS metric_date, 0 AS new_user_count, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS paid_buyer_count, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount), 0.00) AS successful_refund_amount, 0 AS search_count FROM refund_order rf WHERE rf.status = 1 AND rf.refund_time >= #{startAt} AND rf.refund_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(rf.refund_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(sl.created_at) AS metric_date, 0 AS new_user_count, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS paid_buyer_count, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_paid_amount, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS successful_refund_amount, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_log sl WHERE sl.created_at >= #{startAt} AND sl.created_at < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(sl.created_at) ) daily GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date

SELECT metric_date, SUM(paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count, SUM(paid_buyer_count) AS paid_buyer_count, SUM(gross_paid_amount) AS gross_paid_amount, SUM(successful_refund_amount) AS successful_refund_amount, SUM(sold_quantity) AS sold_quantity FROM ( SELECT DATE(p.pay_time) AS metric_date, COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS paid_buyer_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0.00) AS gross_paid_amount, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS successful_refund_amount, 0 AS sold_quantity FROM payment_order p JOIN `order` o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p.status IN (1, 4) AND p.pay_time >= #{startAt} AND p.pay_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(p.pay_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(rf.refund_time) AS metric_date, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS paid_buyer_count, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount), 0.00) AS successful_refund_amount, 0 AS sold_quantity FROM refund_order rf JOIN `order` o ON o.id = rf.order_id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND rf.status = 1 AND rf.refund_time >= #{startAt} AND rf.refund_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(rf.refund_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(p.pay_time) AS metric_date, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS paid_buyer_count, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_paid_amount, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS successful_refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sold_quantity FROM payment_order p JOIN `order` o ON o.id = p.order_id JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p.status IN (1, 4) AND p.pay_time >= #{startAt} AND p.pay_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY DATE(p.pay_time) ) daily GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date
